claims.claim: Opposition-backed candidates won 22 of 27 contested seats in the Czech Senate election.
claims.episode_span: Candidates backed by pro-Western opposition parties won 22 of the 27 seats contested in the 81-member upper house.
claims.source_title: Populist Czech PM Babis goes empty-handed in Senate elections
claims.supporting_quote: Final results from the two-day ballot showed that candidates directly linked to the opposition parties won 22 of the 27 seats up for grabs in the 81-member Senate, retaining a previous opposition majority.

claims.claim: Poland’s Operational Command of the Armed Forces is investigating a suspected airspace violation.
claims.episode_span: Poland’s Operational Command of the Armed Forces stated it is examining a suspected breach of national airspace.
claims.source_title: Poland Investigates Suspected Violation of Its Airspace
claims.supporting_quote: Poland is investigating a possible violation of its airspace overnight, the Operational Command of the Armed Forces said.

claims.claim: At least seven people were killed in the fire at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright according to unnamed military sources cited by CBC.
claims.episode_span: Canadian Broadcasting Corporation coverage, cited by BBC, indicates at least seven deaths according to unnamed military sources.
claims.source_title: Several dead or injured in major fire at Canada military base
claims.supporting_quote: Canadian TV network Global News reports that at least seven were killed and dozens more injured when a gas line or gas well was hit during a live-fire training exercise, citing unnamed military sources.

claims.claim: The Czech Senate has 81 members and the opposition retained its majority after winning 22 of 27 contested seats.
claims.episode_span: Final results from the two-day ballot showed that candidates directly linked to the opposition parties won 22 of the 27 seats up for grabs in the 81-member Senate, retaining a previous opposition majority.
claims.source_title: Populist Czech PM Babis goes empty-handed in Senate elections
claims.supporting_quote: Final results from the two-day ballot showed that candidates directly linked to the opposition parties won 22 of the 27 seats up for grabs in the 81-member Senate, retaining a previous opposition majority.

claims.claim: Canadian Forces Base Wainwright typically has about 690 military personnel and 300 civilian workers on-site on a typical day.
claims.episode_span: The base is one of Canada’s busiest training sites, with about 690 military personnel and 300 civilian workers on-site on a typical day.
claims.source_title: Several dead or injured in major fire at Canada military base
claims.supporting_quote: Wainwright is the main base used by the Canadian military for live-fire training exercises, according to CBC, with about 690 military personnel and 300 civilian workers on-site on a typical day.
